option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: $ports = @(3000,8080,8081); $pids = @(); foreach ($port in $ports) { $pids += Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess }; $pids = $pids | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($pids.Count -gt 0) { foreach ($processId in $pids) { try { Stop-Process -Id $processId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Stopped Windows PID ' + $processId) } catch {} } } else { Write-Output 'No Windows process is listening on 3000/8080/8081' }; wsl.exe -e sh -lc 'for port in 3000 8080 8081; do fuser -k ${port}/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; done'; Write-Output 'WSL ports cleanup finished'
